## Major Projects
- [GPI (Police Global Indicators)](https://gpsi-staging.inrits.tech/) - High-performance Leaflet geospatial mapping and React data visualization platform built for Dubai Police 2024 World Summit.
- [CardioPro](https://cardiopro.fr/) - Business platform for defibrillator renting and training in France. Custom PHP backend, ranks top 5 on Google.
- [React Smooth Scroll (smooth-scroll-react)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/smooth-scroll-react) - Open-source NPM package with 600+ downloads adding customizable smooth scrolling to React applications.
- [Packease.shop](http://packease.hassenbenhadjhassen.com/) - E-commerce travel luggage shop with React, Node.js, MongoDB, and Stripe checkout, attracting over 2,000 unique visitors.
